fixes.description: Completes the previously implemented reversible preview visibility flow. Identity caching excludes root-relative hidden runtime staging and preserves historical IDs for delayed events at moved paths, without weakening real coverage failures or mutation guards. Native hide/restore, right-click/show-hidden, clear-gallery, actual restart persistence and texture fallback toggles preserve exact image bytes.

Windows creation and recovery pin original directory ownership during promotion/removal. Creation-specific recovery removes only the matching empty source/target, retains added or replacement assets for manual repair, validates original root and UUID stage names, and settles interrupted cleanup idempotently. Native configured-junction creation and abrupt subprocess exit at six journal boundaries pass. Non-Windows ownership-bound recovery removal fails closed pending platform-specific support.

Confirmed-stopped games publish successfully without requiring a reload binding or emitting a false manual-reload notice. Running/unknown state retains legitimate manual outcomes. Automatic input rechecks active-game focus. Rust covers stopped/unknown outcomes and unfocused rejection; native publication and absence of the notice pass without launching a game or synthesizing game input.
